criteria.description: The workbook opens and retains every required model sheet.
The repaired 2027 revenue formula produces the independent root-cause result.
The 2027 accounts-receivable result reconciles to the independent operating-model replay.
The 2027 interest expense reconciles to the independent debt-schedule replay.
The 2027 free-cash-flow output reconciles to the independent operating-model replay.
The repaired revenue and downstream cash-flow chain respond correctly to the declared 2027 price perturbation.
The summary free-cash-flow bridge ties exactly to contribution, working capital, and interest.
The 2027 debt-service coverage ratio agrees with the independent replay.
Only the declared root-cause formula cell differs from the starting workbook.
Every declared assumption cell remains unchanged.
Every declared downstream model output remains formula-linked.
The receivables and free-cash-flow chain responds correctly to the distinct 2027 DSO perturbation while revenue, contribution, and interest remain invariant.

review_notes.purpose_zh: 检查唯一的上游公式错误是否被修正，后续对账是否恢复，其他区域是否保持不变。
review_notes.answer_location_zh: 这道题要求在给定模型上做最小修复，所以会检查指定工作表、受保护单元格和公式依赖。
accepted_equivalents_zh: 能恢复同一业务关系的等价公式
不影响模型的说明文字差异
review_notes.not_scoreable_zh: 工作簿无法读取，或被整体重建到无法确认原始保护区域时，应单独记录结构不可比。
review_notes.known_limit_zh: 这是一道简单对照题，用来确认基础修复流程，不足以单独区分系统能力上限。
review_notes.reporting_zh: 当前对外只使用 0 至 1 的连续分数和分项结果；hurdle_criteria 和 pass_threshold 仅为旧运行接口保留。
